claims.claim: Brenmoor Football League's contract K-0005 (EUR 235,000 ARR) expires on 2026-12-31 with 60 days remaining. The notice deadline of 2026-10-02 has already passed, auto-renew is off, and a renewal opportunity at EUR 258,500 (+10%) is at Proposal stage awaiting client board approval.

Brenmoor Football League is a League/Federation segment client in NL, a customer since 2020-08-01 (over 6 years), on the Core tier. They hold 4 products: STREAM (EUR 110,000), INTEGRITY (EUR 50,000), STATS_ARCHIVE (EUR 40,000), and FAN_INSIGHTS (EUR 35,000), totalling EUR 235,000 ARR.

Brenmoor is the #1 ARR account in the League/Federation segment (rank 1 of 5), with ARR of EUR 235,000 versus a segment average of EUR 134,100. Their average utilization is 77.6% compared to the segment average of 81.6%.

The renewal opportunity O-0003 is at Proposal stage with an expected close date of 2026-12-15 and a value of EUR 258,500, representing a roughly 10% uplift from the current EUR 235,000 ARR. Next step is awaiting client board approval.

The notice deadline of 2026-10-02 has already passed and auto-renew is set to N. This means the contract will lapse on 2026-12-31 unless a new agreement is signed — adding urgency to the board approval timeline.

STREAM (Live Streaming) usage has declined sharply year-over-year (-24.2%). In Oct 2025, usage was 570 streamed hours; in Oct 2026 it dropped to 435 hours out of 600 included (72.5% utilization). Earlier in the contract period (2024-12 through 2025-04), STREAM exceeded the 600-hour cap in 5 months, generating overages.

CONFLICT: The Sep 2026 meeting note states the commercial director said streaming usage is 'up massively' since they moved all second-division matches onto the platform. However, usage data shows STREAM YoY change of -24.2%, with Oct 2026 at only 435 hours vs. 570 hours in Oct 2025. The rep should investigate the discrepancy — the client may be referencing viewer counts or a different metric than streamed hours.

INTEGRITY (Integrity Monitoring) usage is healthy with an average utilization of 78.7% and a YoY increase of 2.7%. Usage shows clear seasonality (dips in Jun-Jul off-season) and recent months have rebounded: Sep 2026 hit 279 matches (93.0% utilization) and Oct 2026 at 262 (87.3%).

STATS_ARCHIVE (Historical Stats Archive) usage has grown 7.6% YoY with an average utilization of 71.0%. Oct 2026 usage was 166 queries (thousands) out of 200 included (83.0% utilization), showing healthy engagement but never exceeding the cap.

FAN_INSIGHTS (Fan Engagement Analytics) usage is low and flat, with an average utilization of only 71.3% (18 of 25 active dashboard users in Oct 2026). YoY growth is 8.1% but absolute usage remains well below the included allotment.

The renewal proposal at EUR 258,500 includes a +10% uplift. Given the significant decline in STREAM utilization (-24.2% YoY), the client may push back on the streaming component (currently EUR 110,000) unless the usage discrepancy noted in the meeting is clarified.

Whitespace analysis shows 4 products not held: LIVE_DATA, ODDS_PRE, ODDS_LIVE, and WIDGETS. None are typical for the League/Federation segment (0 of 5 peers hold any). WIDGETS is related to the client's existing STATS_ARCHIVE product, and ODDS_LIVE is related to STREAM, making them the most natural cross-sell candidates.

FAN_INSIGHTS is significantly underutilized at 72.0% with only 18 of 25 included dashboard users active. Consider right-sizing this allocation downward at renewal (potentially saving the client money) or investing in adoption to demonstrate more value.

Support volume is stable: 10 tickets in the past 12 months, unchanged from the prior period (10 tickets). No open tickets currently. Priority breakdown: 3 P2, 5 P3, 2 P4 (prior period had 4 P2, 5 P3, 1 P4 — slight improvement in P2 count).

Average CSAT is 4.14 (down from 4.25 in the prior period) with a 70.0% response rate (7 of 10 tickets scored). Notable: ticket T-0222 (P2 Outage — stream buffering on mobile app for second-division matches) received a CSAT of only 3, which is relevant given the client's streaming expansion to second-division matches.

Two STREAM-related P2 tickets were filed: T-0146 (API latency) and T-0222 (stream buffering on mobile for second-division matches). A STATS_ARCHIVE P2 outage (T-0243, feed unavailable for 20 minutes) was also logged. All are now closed.

claims.claim: At a Sep 18, 2026 relationship lunch, the Brenmoor commercial director described renewal as 'basically agreed' at around +10%, pending board approval. He also said streaming usage was 'up massively' since moving second-division matches onto the platform.
At an Apr 2, 2026 Integrity review, the Brenmoor integrity officer confirmed satisfaction with the reporting format. Two cases were escalated to the league disciplinary panel during the season.

Critical risk: The contract does not auto-renew and the notice deadline has passed. If board approval is delayed past 2026-12-31, the contract will lapse and service could be disrupted. Only 60 days remain.

STREAM usage has dropped 24.2% YoY, contradicting the client's perception that streaming is 'up massively.' If the client reviews actual usage data during renewal negotiations, they may challenge the STREAM pricing (EUR 110,000/yr) and request a lower included-hours cap or reduced fee.
The P2 stream buffering issue on mobile for second-division matches (T-0222, CSAT 3) could become a negotiation lever if the client raises quality concerns during renewal discussions.

Investigate the STREAM usage discrepancy immediately: clarify whether the client tracks a different metric (e.g., viewer numbers, match count) vs. our streamed hours. Prepare a data-backed narrative before the board reviews the renewal proposal.

Follow up on the board approval timeline for opportunity O-0003 (EUR 258,500, expected close 2026-12-15). With no auto-renew and the contract ending 2026-12-31, push for signature no later than mid-December to avoid a coverage gap.

Consider proposing a right-sized STREAM tier (e.g., lower included hours with current pricing reduced) or a multi-year deal to protect the +10% uplift, given the client may notice the lower streaming utilization.

Address the mobile streaming quality issue (T-0222) proactively — confirm the fix is stable and share a resolution summary with the client before renewal sign-off, especially since second-division streaming is a key use case.

Explore a FAN_INSIGHTS adoption initiative or right-sizing. Current utilization is only 72.0% (18 of 25 users). If the client doesn't see value, consider reducing the allocation and reinvesting savings into a cross-sell like WIDGETS (related to STATS_ARCHIVE).
